question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A state of agitation especially over a trivial matter
solution:
The correct answer is "**Fuss**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **The word 'fuss' means a state of agitation, especially over a trivial matter.**(गड़बड़)
 
• It is the most appropriate word for the given group of words.
 
• The word is a noun and can be used in a sentence like
 
 
• "She made a fuss over the small stain on her shirt."
